kypExtensions.summary: The pattern/trap/pivot/mini-case attack structure layered over the source facts.
kypExtensions.rationale: First Aid supplies the two gene tables; the attack structure is a KYP design.

kypExtensions.summary: The two-axis rule (the allele axis: gain-of-function one allele vs loss-of-function two alleles Knudson 2-hit; the gene-class axis: the functional categories — receptor/non-receptor tyrosine kinases, serine/threonine kinase, cytokine receptor, transcription factor, RAS GTPase, antiapoptotic vs negative regulators, cell-cycle blockers, RAS regulator, cytoskeletal, HIF inhibitor, development factors) — KYP's synthesis of the two tables into one reading protocol.
kypExtensions.rationale: The source prints the two tables sequentially without a unified protocol; the framing is KYP's design.

kypExtensions.summary: The four KYP mnemonics (ONE ALLELE GAIN TWO ALLELES LOSS / KNUDSON TWO HIT / SBLA LI-FRAUMENI / THE TWO DELETED DCC SMAD4) — no mnemonic prints on the page.
kypExtensions.rationale: No mnemonic prints anywhere on book 220 (VLM census confirmed); the four codes are KYP's design.

notes: Census (pdfimages + VLM): NO raster images on the page (pdfimages -list returned zero rows for pdf 242). The page is two pure-text tables — the 12-row ONCOGENE table (gain of function, one allele) and the 15-row TUMOR SUPPRESSOR table (loss of function, two alleles — the Knudson 2-hit). The visual is an ORIGINAL KYP adaptation rendering the two tables as a side-by-side panel map (no source figure to redraw). The tables are carried verbatim in the note's table blocks. No copyrighted photographs; no margin mnemonics (VLM confirmed); the KYP memory layer is original.
